ai_summary: Mobile Rider (LiveBarn) saw a traffic spike to origin and SSL handshake errors after activating PM v18. Root cause: from v17 to v18 the origin host changed from PMUSER_IP to AK_HOSTHEADER, and with Cache Key Hostname set to Incoming Host Header, the cache-key hostname took priority when setting the OriginServer, producing the wrong forward hostname. Type: Problem; Priority: Low. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Tracking ticket for IBM Bluemix timing issues following primary problems on the 8.6 rollback (IAD/FRA), with sporadic incidents (KMI install issue SI-00022936, ghost entering a strange state where the manager cycle falls behind while CPU/flit stay tame). Root cause/resolution: memory-allocation install helped most. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Fubon Multimedia (cart.momoshop.com.tw) had the client source port logged and forwarded to origin as 443 (via AK_CLIENT_PORT, passed as Gclientport), tripping the origin WAF's strict check and forcing de-akamaization. Root cause: QUIC updates caused the client source port to be 443 instead of an ephemeral port. Type: Problem; Priority: High; links ERECSO-103. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Citigroup (tts.apib2b.citi.com) saw occasional ERR_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT between ghosts even though the parent reached origin and got a 200, so the end user never received the response. Root cause: network issues between parent and edge (long-haul), broken EIPB+SR, and a non-optimal SS map; rate dropped sharply after prior SR/SS fixes and debug-metadata removal. Type: Service Request; Priority: High; links ERECSO-59. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Internal investigation of a P2 NOCC-facing HSIA DPM/GD Non-Compliant Hostname alert (non-compliant requests >1000) for paymentpage.jetpay.kz. Ticket created to record investigation steps; no customer impact. Type: Problem; Priority: Low. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

ERE checklisting/investigation for the ESSL 18263 (22.2.2) release, validating ghost version and phased rollout monitoring via Lighthouse change-management dashboards. No customer impact. Type: Service Request; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

Salesforce (BT Developer) could inconsistently invalidate quests JSON URLs from Control Center, with translate requests returning 403. Root cause: translate requests were likely impacted by the EdgeWorker component (SYSPURGSUP-301); recommendation was to review with EdgeWorker SMEs. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; links ERECSO-31, ERECSO-28. Resolution: Closed/Won't Pursue.

News Corp Australia (skynewsau-live-premium) saw a low but consistent rate of ERR_READ_ERROR with end users getting 000 responses on latched HLS requests in both ICP and parent. Root cause: latched requests likely waited on MTSE and hit err_read_error, but the client retried and succeeded (000 only before the successful retry), so no real impact. Type: Problem; Priority: Low. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Mastercard (api.mastercard.com, sensitive iccp/* path) reported midgress 5xx (ERR_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT before_resp_hdrs) caused by 256 ghost rolls with SIGSEGV(11) segfault crashes on the rolling parent, similar to ERE-2796. Type: Problem; Priority: High; links ERECSO-47 (software-caused ghost rolls). Resolution: Resolved.

Amazon (www.amazon.in) experienced midgress SSL handshake failures forwarding to parent region 49150 (IPs 2.18.27.12 and 2.18.27.8) within a ~5-minute window on 2025-08-16. Root cause: a 2048 suspend flag in region 49150 caused the midgress failures. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium. Resolution: Closed/Done.

OSI Restaurant Partners had a transient spike in multipleakamaicdnloopheader violations (ghost_cdn_loop_violations). Root cause: additional CDN-Loop headers were still added to requests that already contained them. Type: Task; Priority: Medium; links ERECSO-103. Resolution: Closed/Fixed via GREL-4336.

Ctrip reported midgress logs in their DS2 output despite midgress not being enabled, with origin IP 127.0.0.2 and client IP 127.0.0.1 (loopback) logged briefly during an FF release where CDN Request Loop Protection enforcement stalled after phase 1. Root cause: affected customers shared SR map ID 210007109 (ProxyEcorV4 range for origins without custom map rules). Type: Problem; Priority: Medium. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed; escalated to the SR team (nothing pending on ERE).

National Australia Bank (sit-x.nab.com.au) saw duplicate response headers (CSP, STS, etc.) added at the edge after migrating from ION Premier to ION Standard and changing the SiteShield map and SureRoute. Root cause: client-response metadata being executed twice had re-emerged. Type: Problem; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

ERE checklisting/investigation for the ESSL 18214 (22.2.3) release, validating ghost version and phased rollout monitoring via Lighthouse dashboards. No customer impact. Type: Service Request; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

TelVue's Cloud Wrapper config 'TelVue-Live' (MROM ID 4273) was stuck in an in-progress/ACCEPTED activation state for over 12 hours. ERE was asked to find why the config was stuck and deploy it. Type: Service Request; Priority: High; no customer impact. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Yupp Video's Cloud Wrapper activation (Global-VOD MROM 7169, Cloud-Wrapper-2 MROM 1160) repeatedly failed at the MROM_PUBLISH stage with 'Too many retries. Retry count exceeded max allowed retries.' Type: Problem; Priority: Medium. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Moet Hennessy (lvm-api_prod) derives offload from Breadcrumbs but the c=o (origin) logging was missing for a URL+cookie combination configured as non-cacheable/0s TTL where all requests should be served from origin. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Oracle reported partial objects served to some users in Asia: the edge compressed and served a gzip object to a peer while a parent-to-origin transfer was interrupted; the edge correctly discarded the content-length-mismatched object, but the peer had already cached the incomplete gzip object. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; partial DoS. Resolution: Escalated/Unresolved.

Citibank Singapore (mobile.citibank.com.hk) reported intermittent client-side SSL errors/timeouts for users in HK, SG, JP and others starting 25 Aug, with consistent 'SlowHandshake' messages in cache.log across multiple slots (incl. CITI slot 3589); suspending region 48799 reduced but didn't eliminate the error spikes. No client-side data/PCAP available. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Harmonic (cdn-hkjc-prod AMD) reported recurring 504 spikes on a specific segment; investigation pointed to instabilities across multiple HK regions caused by Electronic Arts' *.heytapdl.com (CP1220401) spiking and impacting co-located customers. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS; links ERECSO-104, ERECSO-30. Resolution: Resolved.

Chengdu MXC (futures.mexc.com) reported high latency specifically on HTTP OPTIONS requests while GET/POST performed normally. Likely tied to a recent platform change preventing request smuggling via request body for OPTIONS, which turned PCONN off for G2G/G2O and terminated C2G connections for OPTIONS-with-body. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; performance degradation; links ERECSO-103. Resolution: Closed/Fixed.

Sky Deutschland (Sky_Community v34) found ghost returned truncated HTML when requesting an object with mPulse (Boomerang) injection and BOTF enabled. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved.

Mastercard (api.mastercard.com) reported midgress first-byte timeouts with a successful reply on the parent, the same pattern as Citi's ERE-2903. Detailed logs/ddc captured for analysis. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS; links ERECSO-31. Resolution: Resolved.

Xero reported high latency on OPTIONS requests after Aug 5/6 (similar to ERE-2920), for non-cacheable content with a US-only origin (AU client -> AU edge -> US parent -> US origin); G2G SSL times were high vs end-user SSL times. Root cause: incorrect escalation. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; links ERECSO-31. Resolution: Closed/Won't Pursue.

Dish Broadcasting saw higher-than-expected origin hits/bytes (~$250K/month revenue impact) tied to Cache Prefresh on QMX files. Root cause: the AMD config kept cache prefresh enabled for linear-streaming file extensions while 'honor origin cache control header' was on - a documented incompatibility between prefresh and cache-control headers. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; links ERECSO-24. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Discovery Communications reported a video re-buffering spike in Georgia US on 2025-08-27 (CP 1452205); region 40517 showed high flits and first-byte timeouts, with ghost rolls and suspend flags confirmed via NOCC/region360 during the window. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; performance degradation; links ERECSO-47. Resolution: On Hold/Unresolved.

Citibank could not add 3 TLD hostnames (accountonline.com, citicards.com, citicard.com) to the EIPB config eip.www4.citi.com, hitting a 400 Bad Request. Root cause: likely introduced by the Territorial Cloud Migration - provider-cloud CIDRs weren't added to the Territorial Clouds in the Anycast Service DB. Resolution: added the provider-cloud CIDR blocks to the corresponding territorial clouds via the EIPB UI. Type: Problem; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Beijing Zeasn's Cloud Wrapper config 'cacheclient' could not be activated, failing at MROM_PUBLISH with 'Too many retries. Retry count exceeded max allowed retries,' blocking activation of the dependent property. Type: Problem; Priority: High; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed (KB referenced).
Event-prep/review for Sony's Asia Cup web event (Culver Max/Sony). Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; no customer impact; links ERECSO-35 (customer event review). Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Rackspace reported images intermittently not displaying for users across multiple states/networks (secure-cdn.scdn6.secure.raxcdn.com), while the origin served the images fine. Root cause: the customer was migrated to a Delivery product since ACE is no longer in use. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.
Greenseer MultiRegion SSL impact alert (MSN) - top SSL slots showing multi-region failure percentage. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

Media event review for the Asia Cup 2025 on SonyLIV (Culver Max), 9-28 Sep across MSL4.x, AMD and NetStorage. Resolution: standard event recommendations including a TD map recommendation. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; no customer impact; links ERECSO-35. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

ERE checklisting/investigation for the ESSL 18236 (22.2.4) release, validating ghost version and phased rollout monitoring. No customer impact; links ERECSO-33 (install-checklisting). Type: Service Request; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.
Internal baseline schema generation for the 22.2.5 release. Type: Service Request; Priority: High; no customer impact. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

Internal investigation to evaluate whether Greenseer's frequent FreeFlow high-ghost-roll alerts are related to Secure ICP rolls. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

Sony Interactive (ps5.np.playstation.net, 2nd-tree SS map s990) saw a high percentage of SSL handshake errors from midgress SS regions starting 3 Sep. Root cause: a misconfiguration in a CricketWireless property amplified localhost requests, memtotaling the SiteShield regions. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS; links ERECSO-48, ERECSO-24. Resolution: Resolved.

Disney (entitlement-v2.hongkongdisneyland.com, slot 17267, VIP 184.84.63.141) had its VIP not served from region 34657, with TLS handshake failing (internal alert). Root cause: an empty Viper data file. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Done.

JPMorgan Chase (apix.chase.com) reported high latency starting 3 Sep; logs identified region 48024 with a high count of client-side slowness. Type: Problem; Priority: High; performance degradation; links ERECSO-24, ERECSO-30. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Citigroup reported EIPB connection issues with odd logs/data (unknown regions, '::' addresses), correlated with ecor-to-ecor loss spikes/drops and frequent arcd rolling alerts in the affected region. Investigation could not reproduce the issue. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Cannot Reproduce.

Washington Post saw a high number of 403s (ERR_ACCESS_DENIED|vr-m) on requests forwarded to Cloud Wrapper because the cloud-wrapper-generic-maps-flits VR (volume-rate) limit exceeded its threshold. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS; links ERECSO-24. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

NBCUniversal saw ERR_FWD_SSL_HANDSHAKE|err_conn_strict_cert from load in region 50303 (localized to IPs 23.55.178.223/.214) ahead of an event. ERE actions considered: temporarily lowering FOM and serial pre-spread to engage more machines for the expected event traffic. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS; links ERECSO-69, ERECSO-104. Resolution: Resolved.

Bank of Montreal uses PM Includes (FCM) for maintenance mode; an 'Include' file change did not reflect on multiple regions (stale metadata). Per ERE-1168 this may be outside ERE scope. Root cause: information not available to determine; could not reproduce. Type: Information Request; Priority: Medium; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Cannot Reproduce.

Internal triage of Greenseer alerts for the week of 2025-09-01 (FreeFlow ghost-roll spikes at 9:26 and 13:46 UTC, plus 42 SSL-slot alerts around 21:00 UTC). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

Placeholder/investigation for SECESC-27802: an escalation originally suspected to be a sophisticated DoS was found not to be an HTTP/2 reset attack but rather stalled threads; ticket holds the work pending a related ERE ticket. Internal triage of Greenseer alerts for the week of 2025-09-08, recording numerous high FreeFlow ghost-roll alerts across 9-08/9-09. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

Credit Karma (CP 530853) saw increased 503s after a 100% traffic ramp on Aug 26, with midgress (edge-to-parent) ERR_FWD_SSL_HANDSHAKE|err_conn_strict_cert errors overloading certain parent machines. Root cause: in-region load-balancing issues at SiteShield due to lack of FSS; pre-spread requested. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; partial DoS; links ERECSO-67. Resolution: Resolved.
ERE checklisting/investigation for the ESSL 18236.1 (22.2.4.1) release. No customer impact. Type: Service Request; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.
Internal baseline push triage for the week of 09/15/2025. Type: Service Request; Priority: High; no customer impact. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

Internal task to validate use of the x-akamai-internal header with JWT. Root cause: Pragma headers were suppressed by a security product. Resolution: review security policies. Type: Task; Priority: Low. Resolution: Closed/Not a bug.

Sky Deutschland reported oddly high average turnaround time, with sample requests showing implausible values (e.g., 4294967270 ms, indicating a counter wrap/overflow). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Escalated/Unresolved.

Discovery Communications (AMD, CP 1794570) saw increased 500s with ERR_PURGE_SEQ_OUT_OF_DATE|httpReadReply from Sept 3. Root cause: a Jetstream agent (jetsagent) connection issue caused unilateral un-subscription from all channel topics, producing an out-of-date sequence number, worsened by rapid (1-2s) customer purge updates on max-TTL objects. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; reviewed in DXRE-2768; links ERECSO-31, ERECSO-30. Resolution: Closed/Not a bug.

Nexon Korea reported that cache:poc2.make-masters-public-early did not work in their config - forward:modify-path still triggered during G2G requests for POC after applying the tag from prior case ERE-558/ETAM-58. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Rejected/Unresolved.

Nexon Korea follow-up to ERE-2951/ERE-558: path modification was applied at the wrong metadata stage, with forward:modify-path triggering during G2G POC requests despite the ETAM-58 tag. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: On Hold/Unresolved.

Sony Group (helpguide.sony.net, CP 133036) saw increased client 500s where the edge failed to MCH (500), then reforwarded directly to NetStorage NSDS getting status 0 ERR_READ_ERROR|no_resp_hdrs, returning 500. Root cause: the URL had an unencoded space in a query parameter, which NSDS does not support, so URL parsing failed. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.
Nordea Bank reported that an EIPB-enabled hostname in Property Manager was stuck showing 'Pending Property Activation' for Edge IP Binding. Type: Problem. Resolution: Resolved.

One97/Paytm (upi.paytm.com, ION Standard, CP 1610892) saw midgress errors (increased read errors and first-byte timeouts) from region r26618 during a 10-minute window on 2025-09-09, caused by '[256] Received Segment Violation' segfault ghost rolls on the parents. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; partial DoS; links ERECSO-47. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Internet Solutions (Dimension Data) found token revocation didn't take effect - users continued playback after a token was revoked (same symptoms as ERE-1114). Root cause: asynchronous revalidation doesn't leave the region and, with jitter disabled, the issue affects all prefresh requests; a DPEREQ ticket was raised to review Prefresh in the TAAS config. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.
Internal triage of Greenseer alerts for the week of 2025-09-15 (high FreeFlow ghost-roll alerts). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

ZEE Entertainment saw multiple 5xx error spikes on live streaming channels on 14 Sep (CP 1819330 and failover CPs). Root cause: Sony used chapacp for ADS (MT) TD traffic, and during the high-traffic IND-PAK match this overwhelmed the chapacp regions, causing machines to suspend and return 5xx ERR_FWD_SSL_HANDSHAKE. Resolution: manifest/AD TD traffic moved to chc1/chb4 and removed as needed. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; performance degradation; links ERECSO-104. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Publix (services.publix.com, SS map s1345) reported repeated midgress SSL error spikes correlating with 2048 suspend flags and high AVG manager cycles. Root cause: TikTok's GCP-CI traffic (maprule 1039) imbalance across the shared SS regions. Type: Information Request; Priority: Medium; partial DoS; links ERECSO-55. Resolution: Resolved.

Alibaba.com (DSAs-ae01.alicdn.com) could not create a new Cloud Wrapper config, hitting 'Properties network type validation has failed.' Root cause: CW Web was only deployed on the FF network, so a DSA property using Standard TLS with an edgekey EHN was not supported. Resolution: fix enabled and confirmed (tracked under ORS-13819). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; performance degradation. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.
Greenseer MultiRegion SSL impact alert (MSN) fired on 16 Sep for top SSL slots with multi-region failure percentage. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

ABN AMRO (www.abnamro.nl) reported a sudden spike in request end time on 10 Sep in region r48545 (IPs 2.20.138.90/.96) until the region was suspended. Escalated as a continuation of ERE-2888, but no matching symptoms (no flit drop, no suspension flags, no stalled threads). Root cause: EdgeData connect errors. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; performance degradation; reviewed in SECESC-28731; links ERECSO-31. Resolution: Closed/Not a bug.

IDFC saw a DPM policy assignment fail with an Audit Trail error, suspected to be a backend tower name resolution problem. Resolution: reaching out to the PAPI team to fully terminate the stuck process and start a fresh one. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Culver Max/Sony saw a 5xx spike at 15:30 UTC during the Asia Cup, isolated to ecors SIFY-DEL and TATA-DEL (recurring problem ecors). Root cause: a downstream origin issue in the MT workflow with AWS as the common connectivity factor. Resolution: FOM capped on some semi-problematic regions (not full root cause); NOCC escalated to the ISP. Type: Problem; Priority: High; performance degradation; links ERECSO-60, ERECSO-30. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Culver Max/Sony saw Pristine workflow failures (0xx ERR_SSL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT|SSLTimeout, 503s to MT polling agents) during the Asia Cup IND-vs-PAK match on 21 Sep, caused by high TD/OS load from spiking APIx traffic in overlapping regions (TD map chc1/387, OS map 4498). Type: Service Request; Priority: High; performance degradation; links ERECSO-104. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Internal triage of Greenseer alerts for the week of 2025-09-22 (FreeFlow ghost-roll spikes, region 23966 orig_hits anomalies, SSL slot 15343 anomaly spikes). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.
ERE checklisting/investigation for the ESSL 18238 (22.2.5) release. No customer impact. Type: Service Request; Priority: High. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

The Cloud Wrapper UI failed to open for some ACC accounts (e.g., Discovery Communications), returning 'Error while initializing app' with a 500 on /fms/api/v1/metadata. Root cause: the account used to authenticate with Akamai's OAuth2 API was temporarily locked due to too many failed logins/invalid-token revocations. Resolution: wait ~15-30 minutes as the system clears unauthenticated tokens every 15 minutes. Type: Problem; Priority: High; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Canal+ Tech reported that DataStream2 logs show the Brave IP in the Edge IP field instead of the ghost that served the request (per TechDocs, the DS2 edge IP should be the serving ghost). Root cause: not applicable; to be reviewed by DataStream SMEs. Type: Service Request; Priority: Low; no impact; links ERECSO-31. Resolution: Closed/Won't Pursue.

Meesho (prod.meeshoapi.com, CP 1692348) reported slowness/high transfer time on 21 Sep, mostly from region 34595. Root cause: congestion/routing issues within Jio's network plus overloaded regions due to Sony's flit-intensive API property during the IND-PK cricket match. Type: Problem; Priority: High; performance degradation; links ERECSO-63. Resolution: Resolved.

SVT reported corrupted content delivered by the CDN tied to the AMD baseline lma.incoming. Root cause: lma.incoming is inserted at client-response stage and force-compresses (gzip) small <860-byte manifests at the parent tier without a status-code match, producing ERR_READ_TIMEOUT corner cases. Workaround (pushed to prod 19 Sep): disable lma.incoming, leaving lma.edge-browser. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

JioStar (jc-ak-dashstreaming.hotstar.com, ak-mediavod.hotstar.com, AMD) saw 400-error failures for Jio ASN 55836 because DNSP mapped users to region r23659 which was suspended for installs - the same issue as ERE-2828. Related: MAPPINGENG-4739, ERECSO-119. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS; links ERECSO-31. Resolution: More Info Needed/Unresolved.

NetEase (h55na.gph.easebar.com v23) saw 404s because the forward ARL appended the base path twice (path duplication on the POC forward to origin) - prepend-incoming-path was applied both in the default origin rule and again in fail-action. Root cause: the host string was added earlier in the request flow to the ARL; resolution requested enabling cache:poc2.make-masters-public-early. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; wrong-behaviour. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

NCsoft saw a 504/ERR_PURGE_SEQ_OUT_OF_DATE from a metrocache edge, after which quick-retry was routed back to the same edge, producing another 504 to the user. Root cause: a known caveat - MCH and fail-action mapping use different strategies (SRO vs fallback/RA-like) with no shared state, so a single machine serving multiple serials can hit this corner case. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS; links ERECSO-117. Resolution: Resolved/Won't Fix (no short-term solution).

PhonePe (apicp1.phonepe.com, CP 1631088, GEO_OPT_IN India) saw two spikes of 503 ERR_READ_ERROR|fwdStateFree on 28 Sep, urgent given 75% of traffic was on Akamai. Root cause: GHOST-4878 - SIACL primary map fails with just a 5xx and triggers no fallback (SIACL-ALT acceptance criteria lack HTTP status codes), so Edge/TD0 fails with err_read_error|fwd_state_free; primarily driven by ghost rolls. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; performance degradation; links ERECSO-121. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Internal triage of Greenseer alerts for the week of 2025-09-29 (SSL slot 15343 anomaly spikes, FreeFlow ghost rolls, region 44746 ssl_hits anomalies). Type: Problem; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Open/Unresolved.

Deutsche Bank requested updating their EIPB config (dbdigitalonboarding-uat-db.com) to a single cloud (eip-terr-as), so that when their hostname is queried from a specified ASN only one of six predefined IPs per IP version is returned (they cannot hardcode IPs). Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; no customer impact. Resolution: Resolved/Complete.

Xtelify saw an increase in 400 'Invalid URL' errors from an MCH parent during the India-vs-Sri Lanka match on 9/26 (CP 1881451), with no corresponding 400s from the origin. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; partial DoS. Resolution: On Hold/Unresolved.

iFood saw intermittent 503 spikes (~0.075% of requests) with ERR_READ_ERROR|fwdStateFree, possibly tied to ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT. Root cause: GHOST-4878 - SIACL primary map fails with just a 5xx and triggers no fallback (SIACL-ALT lacks HTTP status acceptance), causing Edge/TD0 to fail with the forward-state-free read error. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; partial DoS; links ERECSO-121. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Tokyo Chemical Industry (www.tcichemicals.com via China CDN ca map, CP 960696) saw prolonged Out-Of-Country Mapping. Root cause: an influx of traffic from several customers combined with suspended ECORs. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; performance degradation; links ERECSO-82, ERECSO-24. Resolution: Resolved.

Cloud Wrapper availability in Brazil was impacted by packet loss on ecors SDN-GRU2, SDN-GRU3 and FABRIC-GRU. Root cause: IEN sessions on their border routers hit the maximum BGP prefix limit, shifting ECOR traffic to a congested transit link; with 75% of CW capacity in these ecors, traffic moved away from CW (SRO 'No map in assignment msg' failures, increased origin traffic and turnaround time from RA fallback). Type: Incident; Priority: Low; performance degradation; links ERECSO-72. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

ERE (Media) event review for JioStar's West Indies Tour of India 2025 streamed on JioHotstar, including standard checks and overlapping region suspensions. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; no customer impact; links ERECSO-35. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

ERE (API) event review for JioStar's West Indies Tour of India 2025 on JioHotstar (companion to the Media review ERE-2982), with standard checks performed. Type: Service Request; Priority: Medium; no customer impact; links ERECSO-35. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

U.S. Bancorp (EIPB property eipb.convergepay.com.edgekey.net) reported 403s (ERR_ACCESS_DENIED|bad_cn_match) for users behind a proxy hitting hostnames like Dignityhealth.salucro.com - EIPB throws bad_cn_match when the SNI servername is mixed-case. Type: Problem; Priority: High; partial DoS. Resolution: In Progress/Unresolved.

Sercotel reported intermittent high transfer times (4-10s vs an expected <500ms) on AWS API requests since ~July 2025. Root cause: a series of overload cases (e.g., a DoS attack; a Walmart traffic surge) made certain regions slower, with no consistent motif. Recommendations: CRP for future DoS, work with IAT on the Walmart surge, and try APIx for more consistent performance. Type: Problem; Priority: Low; performance degradation; links ERECSO-104. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Coupang (CP 1589472, maprule 15211/api1) faced high Out-Of-Country mapping from Korea (KR users mapped to JP regions) from 30 Sep. Root cause: a BLC push by Map-ops on 30 Sep removed several South Korea regions from the API-X map allowlist (root cause of removal pending under GSPMAPTIX-2317). Resolution: changes rolled back and the region allowlist restored. Type: Problem; Priority: High; performance degradation; links ERECSO-62. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

ERE review for the JPMC event (Amazon Prime Big Deal Days, 10/7-10/8) - IAT asked whether any known map/platform issues existed after problems in a previous event (ERE-2890/2899/2937, GHOST-6772). Outcome: no map or platform issues found; IAT notified. Type: Service Request; Priority: Low; no customer impact. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.

Xero (financial-connect.xero.com, maprule 1626, slot 6513, VIP 23.39.185.38, region 47498) reported SSL handshake timeouts/delays on 10/01 from machine 23.204.137.133, where VIP traffic hit a suspended machine. Root cause: a TRIPd bug where peer MAC address entries showed all zeros in tripd_debug_peers. Resolution: a manual change deployed to trigger a full state request when a zero MAC is detected, restoring proper peer/dest-table info. Type: Problem; Priority: Medium; partial DoS. Resolution: Resolved/Fixed.
